mission.posting: A donating client has requested that a rival's public image be exposed, to more closely match the truth.

email.subject: Expose the truth
email.body:
Hello Agent,
We wish to expose the truth about #TARGET# - they have been maliciously misleading the public with a lying advertising campaign in order to get the edge on our company.
We would like to see this truth revealed on their website - we will consider this contract complete when their own website calls them LIARS.
Thank you, -#CLIENT#
